claims.evidence: Witness only reports an exposed engine assembly with no readable brand/model markings; no confirmation of engine displacement (2.0) or what 'Sensor' refers to.
No vehicle-compatibility markings, part numbers, or engine code are readable in the witness report.
No engine code/part number or fitment documentation is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually be a 2.0 variant (displacement/engine code unknown).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/label (e.g., stamped code on engine block or a visible ID plate) and/or the full part number on the engine/ECU.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used exposed engine assembly (worst case: not confirmed correct variant), with a discount for unknown displacement/engine code.

risks.risk: Unknown running condition (may be non-running, low compression, or has internal damage).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the engine starting and idling (or a compression test sheet and leak-down results if it cannot be started).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: for parts/repair), since the witness report does not confirm it runs.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged key components not visible in the exposed photo (ECU, sensors, starter, wiring harness, sensors, timing-related parts).
risks.proof: A full inventory photo/clip showing all major components and connectors (ECU, starter, alternator, crank/cam sensors, wiring harness, intake/exhaust manifolds) laid out or clearly visible from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness, assuming potential missing sensors/ECU or damaged electronics.

risks.risk: Compatibility mismatch with Passat/Sharan (wrong engine family, wrong mounts, wrong sensors/ECU, different transmission pairing).
risks.proof: Photo of the engine code plus the transmission code/gearbox type, and a photo of the engine mounting points/adapter plate; ideally a fitment document or VIN-based compatibility confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case compatibility (assume it may not bolt up or may require swaps), reducing value until confirmed.

risks.risk: Leakage/overheating history not assessable from the reported images (oil/coolant leaks, warped components).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of suspected leak points (oil pan area, valve cover, coolant hoses/thermostat housing) and a video showing no active leaks during a brief run.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown condition with potential leaks/overheating risk.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate and any stamped markings on the block/head.
Video clip of the engine starting and idling (or compression test results if it cannot be started).
Photos showing ECU, starter, alternator, and all sensors/connectors (including wiring harness condition).
Photos of transmission/gearbox code and mounting/adapter details to confirm Passat/Sharan fitment.
response.reason: The witness confirms an exposed used engine assembly but cannot read engine code/variant or confirm it runs, so the seller’s 2.0 and Volkswagen fitment claims cannot be priced reliably without key proof.
